profile.headline: Software Engineer @ BofA | Enterprise Payments Technology | Modernization & Resiliency Engineer
profile.summary:
Enterprise Software Engineer specializing in event-driven, resilient microservices and
distributed systems. Experienced in Java, Spring Boot, Kafka, and both cloud and on-prem data platforms across the full SDLC. 

Serves as an SME on a high-intensity engineering team modernizing legacy services into scalable, reactive architectures. 

Brings ownership and expertise across development, CI/CD, testing, observability, configuration, governance, and production support. Known for clear communication, cross-team collaboration, and delivering reliable solutions in highly regulated enterprise environments.

positions.locationName: Charlotte, North Carolina, United States · Hybrid

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Lead onshore engineer modernizing legacy MuleSoft integrations into scalable Java/Spring Boot microservices using reactive, event-driven, and resiliency-focused architecture.

Designed and delivered Ash Service, an automated resiliency microservice that identifies events stuck in IN_PROGRESS_EV, logs anomalies, and requeues them into the Outbox for recovery—reducing manual intervention and increasing successful event completion across production systems.

Built and supported distributed services using Kafka, Avro schemas, JSON payloads, and robust retry/error-handling logic aligned with enterprise resiliency standards.

Improved code quality and system reliability with 80%+ unit and integration test coverage, ensuring stable functionality across high-volume merchant workflows.

Owned CI/CD automation and deployment pipelines using Jenkins, Maven/JFrog, and Ansible Tower, ensuring consistent, auditable, and high-quality releases.

Enhanced observability for microservices by creating targeted Splunk queries and log dashboards, decreasing root-cause analysis time for production incidents and improving overall operational visibility.

Acted as a key engineering partner for SRE, QA, architects, and product owners—driving clear communication, design alignment, and rapid feature delivery in a fast-paced agile environment.

Ensured compliance with internal governance, FOSS dependency standards, secure coding practices, and documentation requirements across all services.

projects.title: Accounting Ledger 2.0
projects.description:
Based on Clancy's original Accounting Ledger App (https://github.com/clancycooper/AccountingLedgerApp) we decided to take this clunky CSV file reader/writer based application and reimagine it as a fast and convenient Spring Boot application.
Step 1: Convert the CSV into a SQL Database using MySQL Workbench
Step 2: Reconfigure our file systems from class chaos into an MVC structure
Step 3: Fix bugs in our code with smoother logic by using SQL statements instead of complex Java logic
Step 4: Responsive testing with Postman versus the old fashioned way using the Command Line Interface
List of tests we can now run in Postman:
- Create Transaction
Method: POST
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/create
Response: "Transaction created successfully."
- Get All Transactions
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/all
Response: List of all transactions
- Get Transactions by Month to Date
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/month-to-date/{date}
Replace {date} with the desired date (e.g., "2024-01-23")
Response: List of transactions for the specified month to date
- Get Transactions by Year to Date
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/year-to-date/{date}
Replace {date} with the desired date (e.g., "2024")
Response: List of transactions for the specified year to date
- Get Transactions for Previous Month
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/previous-month/{date}
Replace {date} with the desired date (e.g., "2024-01-23")
Response: List of transactions for the previous month
- Get Transactions for Previous Year
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/previous-year/{date}
Replace {date} with the desired date (e.g., "2024")
Response: List of transactions for the previous year
- Get Payments
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/payments
Response: List of payment transactions (amount < 0)
- Get Deposits
Endpoint: http://localhost:8080/transactions/deposits
Response: List of deposit transactions (amount > 0)

projects.title: Easy Shop
projects.description:
Capstone Overview: Easy Shop is an already existing e-commerce application for technology and electronics. Our team was tasked with releasing Version 2 by fixing bugs that had been reported by users, implementing and editing existing methods, and adding new features.
Bugs
1: Search Filter Bug - Customers noted that search results were incorrect, our team located and fixed the bug by examining the logic of the corresponding prepared statements and queries, leading to correct search results for our customers.
2: Three Laptops - Customer feedback noted duplicate listings for the same product because the update products method was calling on CREATE instead of UPDATE, therefore it was adding a new listing when it should have been editing the already existing one.
New Features:
Shopping Cart - Added a Shopping Cart feature for the roll out of Easy Shop 2.0, tested all Shopping Cart methods, implementations and responses on Postman as well as through the user interface.
Planning Ahead:
We worked together to plan upcoming features of Easy Shop that would create a more accessible, easy to use and functional website. We hope these contributions will help Easy Shop increase customer retention and drive profits.
